places.text: Ten habituated families on the Virunga slopes, one hour with them, eight people at a time.
places.title: Face to Face with Gorillas

places.text: Lion returned in 2015, rhino in 2017; the eastern savanna park now has all five, twenty years after losing them.
places.title: Akagera, Big Five Again

places.text: The Intore warriors' dance, the inanga zither, and drumming that was once the property of the king alone.
places.title: Intore, the Dance of Heroes

places.text: Cultural villages near Musanze where former poachers now guide, and the beekeepers and potters of the Virunga foothills.
places.title: Living Memory

places.text: The annual gorilla naming ceremony at Kinigi, where every infant born that year is named in front of the whole district.
places.title: Kwita Izina

places.text: Geometric imigongo panels in black, white and ochre, and the woven agaseke peace basket that is on the coat of arms.
places.title: Imigongo and Agaseke

places.text: Fabric, fruit and everything else under one roof, and the tailors who will make it up by tomorrow.
places.title: Kimironko Market

places.text: Almost every hillside in Rwanda is farmed in contour terraces — the landscape is entirely made by hand.
places.title: Terraces to the Horizon

places.text: Five cones along the border — Karisimbi, Bisoke, Muhabura — with a crater lake at the top of Bisoke.
places.title: The Virunga Volcanoes

places.text: A steep tea-and-forest walk down to the Isumo falls on the western edge of the Nyungwe canopy.
places.title: Isumo, Under Nyungwe

places.text: One of Africa's great lakes, with no bilharzia, no crocodiles, and the Congo Nile Trail along its shore.
places.title: Lake Kivu

places.text: Sand, palms and calm freshwater at Gisenyi, an hour from the gorilla trailheads.
places.title: Rubavu Lakeshore

places.text: A suspension walkway sixty metres above one of Africa's oldest montane rainforests, with thirteen primate species below it.
places.title: The Nyungwe Canopy Walk

places.text: 227 kilometres along Lake Kivu on foot or by bike, through coffee terraces and fishing villages.
places.title: The Congo Nile Trail

places.text: Grilled goat brochettes, cassava leaf isombe, tilapia from Kivu, and some of the best coffee grown anywhere.
places.title: Brochettes and Isombe

places.text: The reconstructed royal residence at Nyanza, thatched and enormous, with the long-horned Inyambo cattle still kept.
places.title: Nyanza, the King's Palace

places.text: The Kigali Genocide Memorial is where any honest visit to Rwanda starts, and it explains everything that came after.
places.title: Memory and Reconstruction

places.text: Built along ridge lines, swept every morning, and with a monthly Umuganda when the whole city cleans it together.
places.title: Kigali, Across the Ridges

places.text: The Kigali Convention Centre dome, lit at night in the national colours, above a city of red-roofed ridges.
places.title: The Convention Centre Dome

places.text: The last Saturday of every month, the country stops and works on something communal. Visitors are welcome to join.
places.title: Umuganda

places.text: Three hours up through nettles and bamboo to a crater lake at 3,711 m, and three hours back down through mud.
places.title: Bisoke Crater Lake

places.text: A handful of very good lodges within sight of the park boundary, built so the trek starts after breakfast.
places.title: Lodges Below the Volcanoes

places.text: A share of every permit goes to the communities bordering the parks, and gorilla numbers have climbed since it started.
places.title: Ten Percent, Back to the Hills

places.text: The Virunga chain clears for about an hour after dawn, and the terraces below hold the light for longer.
places.title: Mist on the Volcanoes

places.text: Rwanda's newest national park, a recovering forest between Nyungwe and the volcanoes that almost nobody visits.
places.title: Gishwati-Mukura

places.text: Gorillas, canopy forest, Big Five and a lake shore, all within three hours of a capital you can walk at night.
places.title: Small Country, Nothing Missing
